Message from ESO RP Beacon #worldwide-beacon
item.description:
> *Students of the **Bard's College of Solitude** are receiving lesson, today - that being the difference between **noise** and **language**.* > > > *The impetus for this study? A blustering braggart, war-dressed and abrasive. Staff have begun to complain after his presence, owing as much to his 'easterly airs' as to his incessant yammering.* > > *To those unfortunate enough to catch his notice, the demands for song and history come incessant. Is he wanting entertainment, lecturing or simple adoration of his personal exploits?* > > *Perhaps there's a Skald brave enough to chance the barbarian's request? Certainly, his removal from the College would go a ways to earning favor with the College maestros.*
(Character: `Bralgi Floe-Foot` / Username: `@wyrdflex`, Bard's College, Solitude - Western Skyrim )

item.title: Message from ESO RP Beacon #worldwide-beacon
item.description:
*Alas, the rampage went unhindered, every student and scholar made subject to the blustering brute and his pursuits. His quest for knowledge may have gone unanswered, but he left with confidence that his prowess & legend would be recorded, forever, in story....*
(Skyrim departed. May pick this back up in a few hours!)

item.title: Message from ESO RP Beacon #worldwide-beacon
item.description:
*The clamor at the **Eversnow Inn** has reached a new timbre, tonight, with the clamorous character at center of it proclaiming, proud, his intent to storm a nearby camp of giants.*
*The question around the tables isn't whether he truly intends to do battle with giants, but rather if his boasting comes from a place of too much mead.... or not nearly enough.*
(For contact or group - Character: `Bralgi Floe-Foot` / Username: `@wyrdflex`. Location - Eversnow Inn, Western Skyrim (just to the west, a little, of the South Watch wayshrine. Conflict welcome within reason. Potential D20 combat encounter to go with this.)

item.title: Message from ESO RP Beacon #worldwide-beacon
item.description:
*The would-be giantslayer appears to be pursuing his boast, after all, and has torn into the wilderness in pursuit of his quarry. Time will tell if his hunt proves succesful.*
(Beacon moved, but scene still in play. En route to **Karthald Giant camp!** Whisper for invite/directions!)

item.title: Message from ESO RP Beacon #worldwide-beacon
item.description:
*The braggart had made good on his oath. Though the fight had been costly, it had not been without success: two-score giants were felled that eve, with their plunder drug back, made to enrich the whole of **The Eversnow Inn.***
(Beacon departed)

item.title: Message from ESO RP Beacon #worldwide-beacon
item.description:
📍 **Haafingar, Western Skyrim**
*There's been a werewolf sighting at Dragon's Bridge, putting all the locals to flight.*
*While guardsmen keep the perimeter at home, more daring folk take to trek. Returning without hide or hair, they soon settle to a fitful watch over their homes. Yet the sound of distant howling is kept through the night, and more than a few onlookers can ween - just barely - the flicker of distant a campfire across the channel.*
(( Contact: `@wyrdflex` / `Unvlaugh of Karth`. Western Skyrim, just east of Dragon Bridge. NOTE: This area is subject to heavy instancing, so please whisper for an invite and transport! ))
